content:
All the noise in this house overwhelms me so much. Snotty noses. Constant chatter. Shitty pop music and Ed Sheeran at full volume. "HEY GOOGLE". Timers ringing. Youtube brain rot narration videos. "STOP IT!". Groaning. Cars racing by. Coughs. 

I prefer silence.. or my own music. It's the tism for sure.
